title: Copy-on-Write (COW) Lock-Free Context Registry & Transaction Inverse Compaction
author: Brain Harness Autobiographical Reflection Engine (harness-reflector)
context: In high-throughput ReAct multi-agent swarms, hundreds of concurrent agent step loops query the IoC container (context.require(), context.optional()) while background workers register plugins or execute interceptor injections. Traditional readers-writer locks introduce synchronization latency and thread starvation under high read pressure. Furthermore, multi-step agent tool execution transactions (async with context.transaction()) accumulating rollbacks into the parent _dispose_stack cause unbounded closure accumulation and redundant inverse invocations.
distilled_learning: # Copy-on-Write (COW) Lock-Free Context Registry & Transaction Inverse Compaction

claims.assertion: Lock-free COW registry allows concurrent readers to achieve zero lock contention during high-frequency writer mutations.
Transaction commit inverse compaction retains only the latest inverse per _realm_key in reversed order, preventing inverse bloat in _dispose_stack.
Interceptor cache invalidation increments root and child _interceptor_epoch on write to guarantee fresh resolution without lock overhead.
